lines.trans: Dear friends, a moment of attention.

words.gram: nominative plural, masculine, used as address

lines.trans: I want to introduce you to the best chef.
Good evening, dear guests.
This is Maximilian, an expert in French cuisine.
I am very glad to be here.
He kindly agreed to prepare an old dish.
We took it from this French book.

words.gram: 3rd person masculine singular, accusative; г is said like в

lines.trans: I chose this dish for us.
This is an excellent choice for tonight.
Maximilian will prepare it for us today.

lines.trans: I will do everything in the best way.
We are waiting for your culinary masterpiece.

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare
other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
+ genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.

We could open a salon for you.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.text: Из окна красивый вид на парк.

examples.trans: A masterpiece was made out of nothing.
